result.title: Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting
result.summary: Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

AI.brief_summary: 提出谱自适应图 Transformer：以可学习、有向且以当前交通状态为条件的空间算子替代图拉普拉斯特征分解，并用稀疏路网扩散分支与零初始化门控补足局部传播，配合频率箱注意力模块，在保持线性复杂度和更低显存的同时于多个交通预测基准取得有竞争力结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以当前状态为条件的学习混合算子 + 零初始化门控融合全局低秩分支与严格局部扩散分支」可能为 LVR 中 latent 全局推理状态与局部视觉证据分支的融合、以及视觉旁路/信息坍缩问题提供可核查的借鉴线索，但领域较远，迁移属推测。
